description: Get the status of one swap by its id: status and stage (1 waiting for the deposit, 2 confirming, 3 exchanging, 4 sending, 5 finished), rateType (floating or fixed) with payTill (a fixed order's deposit deadline), deposit and payout addresses, amounts, both transaction hashes and the status page URL; while the deposit is awaited the response also carries the payment instruction. Amounts: receiveAmount is the estimate after the network fee; amountReceived is the deposit as credited once seen, and when it differs from amountFrom the estimate no longer applies; amountTo is the actual payout once known. Use it once a swap exists (the id comes from create_swap or from the status page URL). There is no account, so there is no list of swaps and no cancellation: the id is the only handle, and a swap that cannot be completed is handled by support from the swap id. For a price before a swap exists use get_quote. A swap that stops progressing keeps the last stage reached and is flagged in status. Poll at a sensible interval: the endpoint allows 60 requests a minute per IP.

id.description: swap id as shown in the status page URL (sablebolt.io/status/{id}) or returned by create_swap

name: get_swap_status
title: Swap status
